# Forecast fixture provenance

- buienradar_forecast.json: national five-day numerical forecast and condition
  fields from https://data.buienradar.nl/2.0/feed/json, captured 12 November 2026.
  Weather report prose, author details and unrelated observations are excluded.
- weerlive_forecast.json: five-day and 24-hour forecast arrays for the public
  Amsterdam example from Weerlive's documented demo endpoint, captured
  12 November 2026. Key/quota metadata and current observations are excluded.

See the project CREDITS.md for attribution and provider service terms.
The remaining fixtures were inherited from the upstream test suite.
